title: CAIQ SDK + evidence-staging flow for rapid enterprise onboarding
creator: Mariela Torres
description:
Summary: Build a lightweight CAIQ Response SDK plus an evidence-staging workspace to let sales engineers and customers collaboratively complete security questionnaires faster and with machine-verifiable attestations. This is a product + pricing experiment to shorten enterprise procurement cycles by (1) surfacing prefilled answers + evidence templates to customers via an embeddable SDK, (2) allowing customers to stage artifacts and sign a minimal attestation bundle, and (3) offering a conditional pricing credit or onboarding SLA reduction when a customer completes the bundle within the trial/onboarding window.

Why this: Sales teams report multi-week delays caused by back-and-forth on SIG/CAIQ items and missing evidence. Current attachments-heavy workflows increase support overhead. A small embeddable SDK reduces friction, standardizes answer provenance, and enables programmatic verification of evidence to unlock pricing triggers.

Scope:
- Public: embeddable JS widget and REST endpoints for retrieving prefilled CAIQ answers, evidence templates, and current answer state.
- Private: evidence staging workspace in Console (read/write for customer + sales engineer) and signed minimal attestation artifact export (PDF + machine-signed JSON manifest).
- Integrations: light GitHub/GDrive connectors for evidence ingestion and a webhook to push completion events to Sales CRM.
- Pricing experiment: configurable credit applied when attestation bundle status = completed within a 14-day onboarding window.

Out of scope for this pilot: full questionnaire auto-answers via LLM (we will use curated defaults only), heavy-duty policy mapping, and attestation notarization via external legal partners.

Risks & tradeoffs:
- Legal: signed attestations will be minimal and reversible; legal review required to avoid implied warranties.
- Security: SDK must not leak customer answers; sandboxing + token-based ephemeral sessions required (ENG-2045).
- Complexity: avoid feature creep — first iteration focuses on CAIQ + SIG minimal subset, not every questionnaire type.

Acceptance criteria: see acceptance_criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: SDK can be embedded and render CAIQ answers for customer edit with telemetry (success/failure) in staging environments.
Evidence staging workspace in Console supports upload/attach/link of artifacts, versioning, and assignment to a question by sales engineer and customer.
System produces a machine-signed attestation manifest and a human-readable PDF export when bundle is marked 'completed'.
Webhook/Cron event fires to Sales CRM with attestation-completed payload and attachment links.
Pricing credit flow: when attestation bundle completed within 14 days, the customer account is flagged and a credit note is created (simulated in pilot environment).
Security review sign-off obtained and no P0 security findings remain prior to beta release.
plan_steps: Design: final UI flows + attestation schema (owner: DES-1310) - 1 week
Engineering: SDK prototype + staging workspace MVP (owner: ENG-2045) - 3 sprints
Legal & Security: narrow attestation language, KMS approach for signing - parallel
Experiment wiring: define pricing credit rules and reporting dashboard in Console
Pilot: onboard 3 existing enterprise customers (Sales-owned) and measure time-to-complete and support tickets
Evaluate & iterate: adjust evidence templates and credit thresholds based on pilot results
success_metrics: Median time from onboarding kickoff to attestation bundle completion (target: <= 14 days)
Reduction in security-questionnaire-related support tickets (target: -35% vs baseline)
Sales contract close velocity improvement for pilot customers (target: +20% faster)
% of customers who accept pricing credit (target: >= 60% of pilot completions)
False-positive attestation rejections after manual review (target: < 5%)
